Instrument (EN): Health Literacy Practice Knowledge Scale for Nurses — final Taiwan 19-item form
Question count: 19 final (24 preliminary); objective knowledge items, not symptom scale
Scales / measured domains (EN): Knowledge of health-literacy-responsive nursing practice; Rasch knowledge continuum, not proven separate subscales
Research provenance: Chung Y-T et al., BMC Nursing published 2026-10-24 DOI 10.1186/s12912-026-05584-x. Taiwan N434 registered nurses, 11 experts; KR20=.705; Rasch item fit good but person reliability=.59 and separation=1.20. Chinese-language 2025 thesis by first author exists; exact administered final form needs review.
DB locales: not_registered; no HLPKSN key in existing master or app
EN form: Supplementary EN preliminary 24-item translation EXISTS but is NOT a validated 19-item English final edition
Other translations: Taiwan original Chinese-speaking context and Chinese-language 2025 thesis; exact final traditional-Chinese respondent wording not directly confirmed; EN preliminary is not a validated translation.
Target population: Taiwan registered nurses N434, online data collected Nov 2024; professional education, not general psychotherapy population.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: BMC article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (non-commercial, no derivatives); instrument/visual materials and commercial digital administration/scoring/translation rights NOT cleared. Author/publisher explicit rights confirmation required.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / professional group-level knowledge instrument; weak person separation prevents high-stakes nurse scoring; not a clinical mental-health test; do not publish questionnaire/items.

Question count: 29 Likert-type attitude items PLUS separate knowledge subscale (knowledge item number and grand total not confirmed)
